An '''ofuda''' is a special enchanted book sold by the [[Mouthpiece]] in exchange for a [[Sacred texts|sacred text]] and a [[Crystal Heart]] (two for the Prayer of Belial). There are five ofuda, one for each sacred text, and each carries a fixed set of enchantments that is applied in an [[anvil]] like an enchanted book. Ofuda are one of the few ways to get enchantments such as [[Protection]], [[Sharpness]] and [[Mending]], which the pack otherwise makes rare.<ref>{{Cite video|quote=Enchantments are no longer random or use XP to receive. Instead, you craft them, and the rarest, most difficult enchantments to obtain efficiency, unbreaking, protection, sharpness, and mending.}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==
=== Trading ===
{{Sources}}

{{Data/Ofuda}}
<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/librarian/2/avesta.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/librarian/2/tanakh.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/librarian/4/solomon.json}}</ref>

The prayer's name appears in dark gray under the item name, the same way as on a [[Blessing|blessing]].

== Usage ==
An ofuda is used in an [[anvil]] like an enchanted book, adding all of its enchantments to the item where they are compatible. Ofuda do not stack, so only one is used at a time.

{{History|
